title: blue and white modern business proposal
source: Blue and White Modern Business Proposal Presentation.pptx
overall_deck_description: Designed in a widescreen 20×11.25-inch format, this modern business proposal deck uses a crisp, cool corporate palette anchored by deep navy blue, soft steel-blue accents, and an off-white background with subtle paper texture and a soft right-side cyan-blue gradient wash. Typography relies on a bold, high-contrast sans-serif pairing heavy all-caps display headings with clean, structured body text. The deck follows a symmetrical bookend structure: Slide 0 (cover) and Slide 10 (closing) share an identical visual frame featuring top-left logo branding, oversized two-tone hero typography, and a bottom-left URL footer against the gradient wash. Slides 1 through 9 form the body, shifting to clean content layouts with strong left-aligned headers and modular rounded-corner card containers in varying shades of blue to organize data, metrics, and multi-column proposals.
